title: Perp EMA cross
description: A fast moving average against a slow one on the perpetual. Which is on top says the direction of the trend, and the gap says how strong it is.

state.label: Trend state
state.description: Bullish when the nine-period average is above the twenty-one, bearish when below. A fresh cross is the classic trend-change read.

ema_9.label: Fast average
ema_9.description: The nine-period exponential moving average, in dollars. It follows the price closely.

ema_21.label: Slow average
ema_21.description: The twenty-one-period exponential moving average, in dollars. It smooths out the noise the fast one follows.

spread_bps.label: Average gap
spread_bps.description: Fast average minus slow average as a share of price, in basis points. A widening gap means the trend is gathering pace.
